note: Re-judged 2026-10-31: the server now sends windows and gained TestRFC7440ServerWindowOneIsLockstep: windowsize 1 alone draws DATA 1 with no OACK, then silence for 1 s before ACK 1, then block 2; beside blksize 1024, windowsize 1 is left out of the OACK and the transfer is still lockstep. A sender that streams a second block before the ACK is red. grantWindowsize returns 1 for a request of 1, so the transfer takes the same serveFile path as an RFC 1350 request. Client TestRFC7440ClientWindowOneIsLockstep unchanged (each DATA draws its ACK within tftpTimeout/2; an out-of-order block draws nothing).
